title: PANDA: Prior-guided Attentional Dual-path Architecture
abstract: arXiv:2610.13635v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hypergraph Neural Networks (HNNs), designed to model higher-order relations beyond pairwise interactions, typically rely either on fixed structural weights or on normalised attention. Fixed weights can propagate misleading information in heterophilic settings, while normalisation makes attention coefficients competitive, in the sense that, in a message-passing framework, increasing the weight of one sender must reduce the weight of others in the same aggregation set. Our main contribution is the introduction of PANDA (Prior-guided AttentioNal Dual-path Architecture), a plug-in for two-stage message passing HNNs applicable to both undirected and directed settings. The main path interpolates between learned receiver-normalised attention and structural incidence priors, while a non-competitive (not normalised) auxiliary path lets each sender contribute its own transformed information. translated_title: PANDA：先验引导的注意力双路径架构
translated_abstract: 超图神经网络（HNNs）旨在建模超越成对交互的高阶关系，其通常依赖于固定的结构权重或归一化的注意力机制。固定权重在异质（heterophilic）场景中可能传播误导性信息，而归一化会使注意力系数具有竞争性——即在消息传递框架中，增大某个发送者的权重必然会降低同一聚合集合中其他发送者的权重。我们的主要贡献是提出了PANDA（先验引导的注意力双路径架构，Prior-guided AttentioNal Dual-path Architecture），这是一个适用于两阶段消息传递超图神经网络的插件，可同时应用于无向和有向设置。其主路径在学习到的接收者归一化注意力与结构关联先验之间进行插值，而非竞争性（非归一化）的辅助路径则允许每个发送者贡献其自身变换后的信息。我们还证明，在固定结构系数的情况下……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了PANDA——一种可插入两阶段消息传递超图神经网络的先验引导双路径架构，通过将接收者归一化注意力与结构先验插值的主路径和非竞争性辅助路径相结合，克服了固定权重与归一化注意力在异质场景下的局限性。
en_tdlr: PANDA is a plug-in dual-path architecture for two-stage message-passing hypergraph neural networks that interpolates between receiver-normalized attention and structural incidence priors while employing a non-competitive auxiliary path, overcoming the limitations of fixed weights and competitive normalized attention.
